name: Capsule 7B
intro: Capsule 7B. Home: four walls, one window, rent "pending".
Door's locked, the router's dark, and Pixel is asleep on the bed, as is tradition.
Tap a thing to use it. H: hack vision. B: the board, to wire things up.

Door's locked, the router's dark, and Pixel is asleep on the bed, as is tradition.
Tap a thing to use it. HACK, top right: hack vision. BOARD: wire things up.

pages: Home. Four walls, one window, one cat.
Kettle, blinds, bed. In that order, if I am lucky.
E or a tap on a thing: use it.

say.name: YOU
pages: Bed first. The city will still be there.

lock.label: read the plate
say: RENT: PAID. NEXT DUE IN 9 DAYS.

fridge.label: open the fridge
say: one lemon, a battery, and the noodles you did not eat on shift.

fridge.label: look at the photo
say: a photo under a magnet: you and Moth at the noodle stall, steam on the lens. Moth is pulling a face. you are laughing at it.

blinds.label: open
say: the blinds roll up. the city, the colour of weak tea.

pc.label: check mail
say: HOME-PC: 2 new. HARBOR PAYROLL: night shift paid, 3 tokens. CAPSULE TOWER: rent due in 4 days. thank you for being current.

plug.label: switch on
say: SMART PLUG: schedule: night. it is always night in here.
